mapper.select: SELECT kp.*, s.name AS school_name, pkp.name AS parent_name FROM knowledge_point kp LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = kp.school_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point pkp ON pkp.id = kp.parent_id WHERE kp.id = #{id} AND kp.deleted = 0

SELECT kp.*, s.name AS school_name, pkp.name AS parent_name FROM knowledge_point kp LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = kp.school_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_point pkp ON pkp.id = kp.parent_id WHERE kp.school_id = #{schoolId} AND kp.subject_name = #{subjectName} AND kp.deleted = 0 AND kp.status = 1 ORDER BY kp.level ASC, kp.sort ASC, kp.create_time ASC

SELECT kp.*, s.name AS school_name FROM knowledge_point kp JOIN question_knowledge_point qkp ON qkp.knowledge_point_id = kp.id LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = kp.school_id WHERE qkp.question_id = #{questionId} AND kp.deleted = 0 AND qkp.deleted = 0 ORDER BY kp.sort ASC
